“Kasee moko daa repaan iya'a, matana ilio bo pintung ka' wulan sianmo tarang.
Bitu'on bo mandawo' ra'amari na langit ka' pungkuasai langit iya'a bo toyunggot.
Na tempo iya'a mian bo mimiile' Anak Manusia taka ra'amari na lalomna antong tia kuasa balaki' ka' lingkaangan.

Ka' na tempo iya'a uga' Anak Manusia bo momosuu' malaa'ikat-Na umuar kada' bo pingirimpung giigii' mian men Ia ruruki na longkop tano' balaki', ringkat na puusna tano' balaki' pataka na puusna langit.
Inau' a timbaani'na kau ara. Kalu panga'na malalas ka' molusa', ka' muntumbeimo sumumpe, inti'ionmuumo se' tempona pengkar booboomo.
Koiya'a uga' kalu i kuu mimiile' men taeng-Ku' kaekae'mo sida. Inti'ionmuu se' tempona booboomo.
Imamat a men taeng-Ku', ka' uga' bantilkonon-Ku na ko'omuu se' giigii' upa men Yaku' poko bantilkonmo na ko'omuu iya'a bo sida koo'po tia mian men tumuo' tempo koini'i lapus giigii'na.
Langit ka' tano' balaki' bo penta', kasee wurung-Ku isian pataka sidutu.
Kasee sianta sa'angu'po mian men minginti'i iliona tia jaamna. Malaa'ikat na surugaa sian, Anakna Alaata'ala uga' sian. Tongko' Tama na surugaa a men daa ninginti'i.”
“Amo' rame, kasee tio maka'amat. Gause i kuu sian minginti'i kotakaanna tempona.

Tempona timbaani'konon koi sa'angu' mian men namarerei laiganna ka' namarasayakon na tutulungina bo pinginti'i laiganna iya'a. Ka' giigii' tutulungi sanda' nitarai men bo dagaionna. Ka' uga' i ia nomosuu' dadagai soopan balaki' badaga pore-pore.
Mbaka' mandagaisi, gause i kuu sian minginti'i se' ipi a kotakaanna tombonona laigan iya'a, too guntumalom, kabai tanga'na rondom, kabai karani' ilio kabai se' too ma'ulo-ulop tuu'.
Kada' kalu ola-olan taka i ia, amo' takaionna i kuu pintanga' royot.
Upa men Yaku' bantilkonmo i kuu, bantilkonon-Ku uga' na mian wiwi'na se' badaga!”
Dauga' koi rua' ilio muntumbeimo pangaramekonan Paska tia ramean Roti Sianta Ragina. Tanaasna imam tia wawa ukum Torat, nansarakmo salan mangarakop i Yesus wuni-wuni ka' mampapatei.
Taena i raaya'a, “Amo'po wawauon na tempo ramean, dako' mantakakon kogora'an na mian biai'.”

Sarataa i Yesus na Betania, na laigan ni Simon men kustaon mbaripian, taka a wiwine sa'angu' nangawawa botor men watu pualam isiian minamina' narwastu. Minamina' narwastu iya'a alayo' tuu' a angga'na gause sianta baurna. Pintanga' kumaan i Yesus, ia pula'imo wiwine iya'a a talopna botorna, kasi nitimbu'ikon takala' ni Yesus.
Toropii a mian indo'o nomaso'mo, ka' nopootundunii simbaya'na, taena, “Upa a kana'na minamina' narwastu kale'e ka' lalaision?
Gause minamina' narwastu kale'e sida balukkonon tolu'atu labi doi' dinar, ka' ilina sida obo-oboskonon bona mian talalais.” Mbaka' ia komaso'i i raaya'a a wiwine iya'a.
Kasee taeni Yesus, “Patalai i ia. Nongko'upa i kuu se' mampapolosi noana? Ia nangawawaumo upa men pore na Ingku'.
Ka' mian talalais sinampang isian na ko'omuu. Sanda' ilio kalu i kuu mingkira', sidaonmuu laweion i raaya'a. Kasee i Yaku' sian sina-sinampang tii kuu.
Ia nangawawaumo upa men daa sidaonna wawauon. Wakang-Ku ia poko minamina'imo bookoi pontoropotianna bo pantanoman i Yaku'.

Imamat a men taeng-Ku', ka' uga' bantilkonon-Ku na ko'omuu se' longkop tano' balaki', mau maana a pengelelekonan Lele Pore, ino'o uga' upa men ia wawaumo wiwine kani'i bo bantilkonon bookoi pinginau'an i ia.”
Na lalomna sompulo' rua' murit ni Yesus isian sa'angu' mian men ngaanna i Yudas Iskariot. Ia nomae' nari tanaasna imam bo mongorookon i Yesus na ko'ona i raaya'a.

Wiwi'na i raaya'a nobeles tuu' nongorongor men ia bantilkon i Yudas, ka' i raaya'a nontoon i ia se' bo taraionna doi'. Noko daa iya'a, ai Yudas nansarakmo salan men daa pore bo pongorookonanna i Yesus.

Na ilio tumbena pangaramekonan Roti Sianta Ragina mian malia' mongkoyo' domba Paska. Tempo iya'a murit ni Yesus nobapikirawar na Ko'ona, taena, “Maana po'uus-Muu bo pontoropotianmai kakaan bo pangaramekonan Paska?”
Kasi i Ia nomosuu' rurua' murit-Na, tae-Na, “Rae' na kota. Nda'a na kota i kuu bo pootuung sa'angu' moro'one tumambu' mangawawa gumbang buke' a weer. Lolo' i ia.
Na laigan men pinsoopanna, bantilkon na tombono laigan iya'a, inta': Potuunna Guru: maana a tampat men bo pangkaanan kakaan ramean Paska tia murit-Ku?
Tombono laigan iya'a bo minsiso'kon na ko'omuu sa'angu' olisna parawawo men balaki' men noko toropotmo tia pakakasna. Toropoti a kakaan bo ko'onta'.”
Kasi rurua' murit ni Yesus nomae' na kota iya'a. Ia takai i raaya'a wiwi'na sintutu' koi men taeni Yesus. Raaya'a uga' nontoropotimo kakaan men bo kaanon na Paska iya'a.
Sarataa malommo taka i Yesus tia murit-Na sompulo' rua' na laigan men nitoropotimo.
Poto'oruang i raaya'a kumaan, ai Yesus norobumo tae-Na, “Imamat ini'imari! Bantilkonon-Ku na ko'omuu se' isian i kuu men bo mongorookon i Yaku' kada' papateion, men pintanga' kumaan tii Yaku'.”
Tongko' nongorongor iya'a, mbaka' noana i raaya'a nasiongo'mo. Raaya'a norobumo sa'angu'-sa'angu' taena, “Taasi'po i yaku', indo'?”
Taeni Yesus, “Mian iya'a sa'angu' mian na ko'omuu sompulo' rua' i kuu ka' men mongorom rotina na lalomna mangko' patombongan tii Yaku'.
Tuutuu' mba'a se' Anak Manusia bo lapus koi men nipoko tulismo na Alkitaap. Kasee silaka' a mian men mongorookon Anak Manusia. Mian iya'a bagia sian nidodongokon.”
Pintanga' kumaan i Yesus tia murit-Na, Yesus nangalamo roti, nobasukuur ka' nungurumpi-rumpik, kasi nongorookon na murit-Na ka' norobu tae-Na, “Alamo, ni'imo a wakang-Ku.”
Noko daa koiya'a, Ia ala a pinginuman tia anggur ka' nobasukuur na Alaata'ala kasi nongorookon i raaya'a, ka' wiwi' irana ninginum anggur iya'a.
Ia norobumo taena, “Ni'imo a rara'-Ku men mamakadodor toonna Alaata'ala. Rara'-Ku tonturo' bona mian biai'.

Imamat a men taeng-Ku', ka' uga' bantilkonon-Ku na ko'omuu se' Yaku' sianmo minginum anggur soosoodo pataka na iliona men bo pinginuman-Kumo anggur men u'uru iya'a ruru-ruru' tii kuu na Batomundo'anna Alaata'ala.”
Noko daa nangananikon nanian puntunde', raaya'a nomae'mo na Buu'na Zaitun.
Yesus norobu na ko'ona i raaya'a, tae-Na, “Kuu giigii' kuuna sianta mantaan a noamuu. Gause nipoko tulismo a wurungna Alaata'ala, ‘Bo poolon-Ku a pontondong domba ka' giigii' domba bo bagera-gerap.’
Kasee moko daa i Yaku' potuo'ion, Yaku' bo mongolukoni i kuu na Galilea.”
Ia simbati i Petrus, taena, “Mau i raaya'a giigii' sianta mantaan a noana, see men i yaku' mokotaan.”
Taeni Yesus, “Tuutuu' mba'a. Kasee bantilkonon-Ku na ko'oom se' rondommo kani'i, koo'po tia paraa muntuturuu' a siok kopinduanna, koo noko porotolumo minsasapu na Ingku'.”
Kasee i Petrus nanggagai, taena, “Yaku' mau pate tii Kuu, sian minsasapu na Ko'omuu.” Giigii' murit men sambana uga' nangaan men koiya'a.
Taka i Yesus tia murit-Na na tampat men ngaanon Getsemani. Taeni Yesus na murit-Na, “Oruang karaa'ita. Yaku' dauga' mae' sambayang.”
Kasi i Yesus nangange i Petrus, Yakobus, ka' i Yohanes mae' tii Ia. Muntumbeimo i Ia munsuri marepa tuu' ka' siasa.
Taeni Yesus na ko'ona i raaya'a, “Noang-Ku masiongo' tuu', koi se' kolapus-Kumo surion. Kuu ka'itamo ka' maka'amat.”
Ai Yesus nomae'mo ndee-ndee'e, kasi notumutuku' rumbuk tano' ka' nosambayang. Na sambayang-Na, Ia mama'ase' too daa sida kada' i Ia amo' munsuri repaan men bo tumaka.
Taeni Yesus, “Oo Papa, Tamang-Ku! Giigii' upa ai Kuu a Pinginti'i. Anui a repang-Ku kani'i na wakang-Ku. Mau koiya'amo, taasi' pingkira'-Ku a lolo'on, kasee pingkira'-Muu a lolo'on.”
Noko daa iya'a i Yesus nomule'konmo. Ia takai a murit-Na nokoroyotmo. Ia norobumo ni Simon Petrus, tae-Na, “Simon, se' royot i koo? Sian mbali' i koo momoko moburar badaga sa'angu' jaam?”
Kasi i Yesus norobu na ko'ona i raaya'a, tae-Na, “Maka'amat ka' basambayang dako' i kuu topongionna upa men ba'idek. Noamuu mo'uus mangawawau men kana', kasee i kuu sian mokotaan.”
Kasi i Ia nomae' soosoodo ka' nosambayang men koi Ia tundun na sambayang-Na umba'a.
Ka' sarataa i Ia nde'emari soosoodo, Ia takai i raaya'a pintanga' royot, gause i raaya'a nototundo'mo. Raaya'a sianmo ninginti'i i se' koi upa a bo pinsimbati i Yesus.

Ai Yesus nomae'mo nosambayang ka' nomule'kon soosoodo koporotoluna na ko'ona i raaya'a. Taeni Yesus, “Nongko'upa se' dauga' royot i kuu ka' mintimale? Daamo. Takamo a tempona. Piile'! Anak Manusia rookononmo na limana mian men dosaon.
Wangon, mai kita mae'mo. Ai ia men mongorookon i Yaku' takamo.”

Pintanga' i Yesus dauga' morobu, notakamo i Yudas, sa'angu' mian men tonsoop sompulo' rua' murit ni Yesus. Ka' men nongololo' i ia mian biai' potowawa bakoko' tia popool. Raaya'a ia posuu' tanaasna imam ka' wawa ukum Torat, tia motu-motu'a.
Ai Yudas men bo mongorookon i Yesus noko pambantilkonmo oosan kani'imari na ko'ona i raaya'a, taena, “Mian men ookionku, ya'amo i Ia. Rakop ka' wawa i Ia. Dagai pore-pore.”
Tongko' notaka i Yudas imba'a, ia liuliu nuntuu'i i Yesus ka' norobu taena, “Guru!” Kasi ia nongooki i Yesus.
Mbaka' ia intonimo i raaya'a i Yesus ka' nirakop.
Isian sa'angu' mian men indo'o tii Yesus numbubut bakoko'na ka' nontotok sa'angu' ata'na Imam Moola', tamban nokopantas a tilingana.
Yesus norobu na ko'ona i raaya'a tae-Na, “Pansaruimuu se' i Yaku' too mian puraga mbali' i kuu taka poto'inton bakoko' tia popool bo pangarakop i Yaku'?
Sanda' ilio i Yaku' monda'a tii kuu mimisiso' mian na tolodona Laiganna Alaata'ala, see i kuu sian nangarakop i Yaku'. Kasee tio koiya'a kosidana kada' sidamo a men nitulis na Alkitaap.”
Kasi giigii' murit-Na kabus namarere ka' namarerei i Ia.
Sa'angu' anak malai moro'one, na malom iya'a tongko' nokalimbut toik lenang, mae' nongololo' i Yesus. Ia intoni i raaya'a a mian iya'a bo rakoponna,
kasee liuliu ia tikarkon a kalimbutna ka' notumetende' lada-ladak.
Tongko' daa koiya'a, ai Yesus niwawamo na Imam Moola'. Wiwi'na tanaasna imam ka' motu-motu'a tia wawa ukum Torat nobarimpung indo'o.
Petrus nuntuntuni i Yesus kasee olo-oloa mae' na tolodona Imam Moola'. Inda'a i ia no'umoruang nintingola' nari dadagai ka' ninguru.
Tanaasna imam tia wiwi'na mianna Mahkama Agama mansarak mian bo pomborekkon i Yesus kada' i Ia tio ukumon pate, kasee i raaya'a sian nantausi sala'-Na.
Biai' uga' a mian men nomborekkon i Yesus, kasee tundunanna i raaya'a sian pootutu'.
Kasi isian toro pii mian nokumekerer ka' nomborekkon wawau i Yesus, taena,

“Kai nongorongormo mian kaya'a nobatundun, tae-Na, ‘Yaku' bo munguruntun Laiganna Alaata'ala men ia wawau mian, kasee na lalomna tolu' ilio pokereron-Kumo a laigan sambana, men taasi' ia wawau mian.’”
Ya'apo tundunanna i raaya'a sian pootutu'.
Imam Moola' nokumekerermo na tanga-tanga'na mian biai' ka' nimikirawari i Yesus, taena, “Nongko'upa i Koo se' sian minsimbati? Koi upa men ia raitkon mian karaaya'a na Ko'oom?”
Kasee i Yesus tongko' roko-rokot, sian ninsimbati. Imam Moola' dauga' nimikirawari i Yesus soosoodo, taena, “Too i Koo a Tomundo' Pansalamatkon, Anakna Tumpu Tontunde', kabai taasi'?”
Taeni Yesus, “Yaku'mo mba'a inono'. Ka' i kuu bo mimiile' Anak Manusia umoruang paraas uananna Alaata'ala Men Pungkuasai, ka' taka ra'amari langit na tanga-tanga'na antong.”
Nongorongor wurung ni Yesus, Imam Moola' nemberak pakeanna ka' norobu taena, “Bo upa ka' dauga' mansarak mian bo pinginti'ianta?
Kuu daa nongorongormo i Ia ningidek Alaata'ala. Koi upa i kuu?” Kasi i raaya'a nompoposa'angu' wurungna i raaya'a, se' ai Yesus tiodaa ukumon pate.
Kasi toropii mian ninginori i Yesus ka' nongompodi ro'up-Na ka' numukul i Yesus, kasi norobu na Ko'ona, taena, “Io nabii, ngaan too i ime a numukul i Koo.” Tamban ari dadagai numukul i Ia.
Tempo iya'a i Petrus dauga' indo'o na tolodo, taka sa'angu' wiwine men ata'na Imam Moola'.
Ia toopiile' se' isian i Petrus minguru, ia pakalolo'imo a dudusna, taena, “Ai koomo mba'a a men poopoololo' tii Yesus, samba Nazaret iya'a.”
Kasee i ia ninsasapu, taena, “Sian inti'ionku ka' sian arationku se' upa a panduuwung.” Kasi i Petrus nomae' na soopan balaki' na gandaria. [Tempo iya'a nuntuturuu'mo a siok.]
Ia piile' wiwine iya'a se' isian i Petrus soosoodo, ia norobumo na mian iraando'o, taena, “Mianmo kani'i mba'a a samba-sambana i raaya'a.”
Kasee i Petrus ninsasapu soosoodo. Sian paraa nanau' mian men isian iraando'o norobu ni Petrus taena, “Sabole i koo tonsoop tii raaya'a, gause i koo mase samba Galilea.”
Kasi i Petrus nobatadean ka' nobasumpa', taena, “Yaku' mase sian inti'ionku inooro'o mian men kuu ngaan.”

Singka-singkat iya'a, nuntuturuu'mo a siok men kopinduanna. Liuliu notonginau' i Petrus se' ia poko bantilkonmo i Yesus, taena, “Koo'po tia siok muntuturuu' men kopinduanna, ai koo noko porotolumo minsasapu na Ingku'.” Petrus liuliu nowiri, tamban bolingongoton.
Ma'ulo'-ulop tuu', ari tanaasna imam tia motu-motu'a ka' ari wawa ukum Torat, tia wiwi'na mianna Mahkama Agama nomosa'angu'mo wurung. Ia pungu i raaya'a i Yesus, kasi niwawa taka ni Pilatus.
Pilatus nimikirawarimo i Ia, taena, “Koomo a tomundo'na lipu' Yahudi?” Ia simbati i Yesus tae-Na, “Koi nooro'o men taemuu.”
Liuliu tanaasna imam nambantilkon biai' kaliangan mangarait i Yesus.
Kasi ia pikirawari i Pilatus soosoodo, taena, “Nongko'upa i Koo se' sian minsimbati? Rongor, biai'mo kaliangan a wurungna i raaya'a mangarait i Koo.”
Kasee i Yesus santaa'po sianmo ninsimbati, tamban i Pilatus nosamba'mo.
Koi men nodelemo sanda' taun na pangaramekonan Paska, ai Pilatus munguarkon sa'angu' mian na tarungkuan men koi pa'ase'na mian biai'.
Na tempo iya'a isian mian ngaanon i Barabas tia mian toro pii men sian momorongori pamarenta. Raaya'a nitarungku singka-singkat, gause nampapateimo mian na tempo nangawawau kogora'an.
Mbaka' notakamo ni Pilatus a mian biai' mama'ase' kada' munguarkon sa'angu' mian na tarungkuan koi men nodelemo.
Ia pikirawar i Pilatus, taena, “Ko'uusmuu a tomundo'na lipu' Yahudi kani'i uarkononku?”
Pilatus inti-inti'i se' tanaasna imam nangkalaakkon i Yesus gause i raaya'a kokoo'ankon i Yesus.
Kasee tanaasna imam nomosuu' mian biai' mama'ase' ni Pilatus kada' i Barabas a men uarkonon bo ko'ona i raaya'a.
Dauga' ia pikirawari i Pilatus soosoodo, taena, “Ansee ka' koiya'a upaionkumo a mian kaya'a men taemuu se' tomundo'na lipu' Yahudi?”
Liuliu nangkakaro' i raaya'a, taena, “Saliipkonmo a mian kanono'!”
Kasee taena i Pilatus na ko'ona i raaya'a, “Kasee idek upa a men Ia poko wawaumo?” Kasee i raaya'a tongko' kaekae' dodoa mangkakaro' taena, “Saliipkon a mian kanono'!”
Gause i Pilatus mingkira' mompobeles noana mian biai', ia ala uarkon i Barabas men koi kikira'na i raaya'a, ka' ia posuu'konmo i Pilatus mian mansasali i Yesus, kasi nongorookon bo saliipkonon.
Noko daa iya'a, ai Yesus ia wawamo surudadu minsoop na tolodona laiganna Gubernuur, kasi nileelo' a surudadu wiwi'na barimpung.
Raaya'a nimpisoki i Yesus tia juba kakamumu', kasi nanganam sa'angu' likok ruri' niwawau koi mahkota ka' nunsulon na takala'-Na.
Noko daa iya'a, raaya'a nantabe'imo i Yesus, taena, “Tabea', oo tomundo' na lipu' Yahudi!”
Kasi ia pool i raaya'a a takala' ni Yesus tia tokon ka' ni'inori, kasi nobanintuur ka' nonsoosa' i Yesus.
Noko daa i Yesus nibibiani, ia ukatimo i raaya'a a juba-Na men kakamumu', kasi nipopisokikon a pakean-Na soosoodo. Noko daa iya'a, kasi ni'uarkon kada' bo saliipkonon.
Tempo iya'a, isian sa'angu' mian nolumiu, ngaanna ai Simon, samba Kirene, tama ni Aleksander tii Rufus. Ia baasi sai takana na kota. Liuliu ia pakisaa i raaya'a mamasa'an saliip ni Yesus.
Yesus ia wawamo i raaya'a na sa'angu' tampat men ngaanon Golgota, aratina: Tampat Lamasna Takala'.
Kasi i Yesus ia tarai i raaya'a anggur nibaur muur pakuli' pangalalapi polos, kasee ia nobude' ninginum.
Noko daa iya'a, ia saliipkonmo i raaya'a i Yesus. Kasi ni'obo-obos a pakean-Na, ka' ni'undi bo pinginti'ian too i ime a men mangala.
Nansaliipkonan i Ia, na jaam 9 ma'ulop.
Mbali' i Ia ni'ukum, daa piile'on na tulisan men nipakampa' inda'a na saliipna, men nitulis: Tomundo'na Lipu' Yahudi.
Singkat tii Ia uga' isian rurua' mian puraga nisaliipkon, sa'angu' paraas uanan-Na ka' sa'angu' paraas kauri'-Na.
[Ka' koiya'a, nosidamo a men nitulis na Alkitaap, taena, “Ia uga' tonsoop saa'na mian men ba'idek a gau'na.”]
Mian men lumiu inda'a ningililokkon takala'na ka' mingiroki i Yesus. Raaya'a norobu taena, “Wee i Koo men bo munguruntuni Laiganna Alaata'ala ka' tongko' tolu' ilio pokoowonmo patindongon soosoodo,
palau na saliiwip kanono' ka' salamatkon a wakaam.”
Koiya'a uga' tanaasna imam tia wawa ukum Torat ningiroki i Yesus. Raaya'a nopootundunii simbaya'na, taena, “Mian sambana pokoon-Na salamatkonon, kasee waka-Na sian pokoon-Na salamatkonon!

Kalu i Koo tuutuu' Tomundo' Pansalamatkon, Tomundo' na Israel, ansee koini'i palau na saliip kanono' kada' piile'onmai ka' parasayaonmai.” Mau rurua' mian men nisaliipkon singkat i Yesus uga' mangaani i Ia.
Na jaam duablaas, nopintungmo a longkop libutan iya'a pataka jaam tiga.
Ka' na jaam tiga i Yesus nangkakaro'mo men boolak tae-Na, “Eli! Eli! Lema sabakhtani?” Aratina: Alaata'alang-Ku! Alaata'alang-Ku! Nongko'upa se' i Kuu mandalai i Yaku'?
Nomorongor iya'a, toropii mian men potokerer iraando'o norobu taena, “Rongor, Ia mengeleelo' i Elia.”

Liuliu nomae' a mian sa'angu' nangala garanggan mongura' ka' nongorom na anggur makarang, kasi ia potoor na kau ka' nisoorkon waara'a, mimi'inumi i Yesus. Kasi norobu taena, “Daa, peperaionta ka' piile'on too i Elia taka mantaro' i Ia.”
Noko daa iya'a, Yesus nangkakaro'mo boolak kasi nopudul a noa-Na.
Singkat iya'a, toik pongola' na Laiganna Alaata'ala nokoberak rua' inda'ana tudun indo'ona.
Tempo tanaasna surudadu men nokumekerer na arop ni Yesus, nimiile' lalapus-Na se' koiya'a ka' nopudulmo a noa-Na, mbaka' ia norobumo taena, “Mian kani'i tuutuu' Anakna Alaata'ala!”
Isian uga' toro pii wiwine men montoa'i na ko'oloaan. Raaya'a ai Maria Magdalena, Salome, ka' i Maria sina ni Yakobus men itiu' tii Yoses, ka' isian uga' men sambana.
Wiwi' irana nongololo'mo i Yesus ka' nangkalesang tempona i Ia na Galilea. Ka' isian wiwine sambana iraando'o men noko takamo na Yerusalem tii Yesus.
Guntumalom notakamo, ka' ilio iya'a ilio batoropotan men montorumpaki ilio Sabat.
Mbaka' Yusuf, samba Arimatea, sa'angu' mianna Mahkama Agama men tongaan, men uga' mempeperai Batomundo'anna Alaata'ala, nambaranikon noana mae' ni Pilatus ka' mama'ase' biibii ni Yesus.
Pilatus nosamba' nongorongor se' i Yesus nolapusmo. Mbaka' ia nengeleelo'mo tanaasna surudadu ka' nimikirawar na ko'ona too nolapusmo i Yesus.
Sarataa ia rongor na tanaasna surudadu se' koiya'a, ai Pilatus namatalaimo i Yusuf mondolo' biibii ni Yesus.

Kasi i Yusuf ningili toik pobalun, ka' noko daa iya'a, ia taro'konmo a biibii ni Yesus men na saliip ka' nambalun tia toik pobalun. Pobalun iya'a, toik lenang a niwawau. Kasi ia nomotokol biibii ni Yesus na baleanan men nipa'atkon na buu'na watu. Noko daa iya'a, ia ningilinda'mo watu ka' nongompodi soopanna baleanan iya'a.
Maria Magdalena tii Maria sina ni Yoses nimiile' i Yesus nipotokol na baleanan iya'a.
Sarataa noporus a ilio Sabat, ai Maria Magdalena, Salome, ka' i Maria sina ni Yakobus, ningilimo rampa bo pintimbu'i biibii ni Yesus na lalomna baleanan.
Na Minggu, ilio tumbena minggu iya'a, ma'ulo'-ulop bete' a ilio, raaya'a nomae'mo na baleanan.
Raaya'a nopootunduniimo, taena, “Ai ime inta' a bo pingilinda'kon i kita watu men na soopanna baleanan?”
Kasee karani'mo i raaya'a, ia piile' a watu men balaki' tuu' iya'a noko tolinda'mo.
Liuliu raaya'a ninsoop na baleanan. Ia piile' i raaya'a paraas uananna isian sa'angu' anak malai mojuba bubulak umoruang paraas uanan. Raaya'a notongkodi' tuu'.

Kasee anak malai iya'a liuliu norobu na ko'ona i raaya'a, taena, “Alia layaon! Kuu mansarak i Yesus samba Nazaret men nisaliipkon iya'a. Ia notuo'mo soosoodo. Ia sianmo kani'i. Piile'! Kani'i a tampat men nomotokolanna i raaya'a i Ia.
Kasee koini'i, rae' i kuu, bantilkon murit-Na ka' i Petrus, inta', ‘Ai Yesus mongolukoni i kuu na Galilea. Ntu'uasi ka' piile'onmuu i Ia, koi men Ia poko bantilkonmo i kuu itaan.’”
Raaya'a liuliu no'umuar ka' notumetende' namarerei baleanan iya'a, gause notongkodi' ka' nolayaon tuu'. Raaya'a sian nontootundun upa-upa na sa'angu'po mian, supu-supuanna nolayaon.

Sarataa i Yesus notuo' soosoodo, na Minggu ma'ulo'-ulop, na ilio tumbena na minggu iya'a, tumbena tuu', Ia nintipiile' ni Maria Magdalena, men mbaripian ia buse'i i Yesus a meena pipitu' men nangalampingi i ia.
Kasi i Maria Magdalena nomae' nambantilkon na mian men sinampang mongololo' i Yesus, men tempo iya'a dauga' masiongo' ka' wiri.
Ia rongor i raaya'a se' i Yesus notuo'mo soosoodo ka' ia piile'mo i Maria Magdalena, kasee i raaya'a dauga' sian mamarasaya.
Noko daa koiya'a, isian murit ni Yesus rua' ira no'umuar namarerei kota. Yesus nintipiile' na ko'ona i raaya'a see poosasala' tia nintipiile'-Na ni Maria Magdalena.
Raaya'a nomule'konmo ka' nambantilkon simbaya'na, kasee i raaya'a dauga' sian mamarasaya.

Komburi'na ia nintipiile'mo na murit-Na men sompulo' sa'angu' ira iya'a, na tempo i raaya'a pintanga' kumaan. Ya'asi kasi ia sasala' i Yesus a men sian laan parasaya, ka' men baroan a noana, sian mamarasaya mian men noko pimiile'mo i Yesus men notuo'mo soosoodo.
Kasi i Yesus norobu na ko'ona i raaya'a, tae-Na, “Rae' i kuu na longkop tano' balaki' ka' lelekon a Lele Pore bona giigii' mian.
Mian men parasaya ka' saranion, ia bo salamatkonon. Kasee mian men sian parasaya, bo ukumon.
Mian men parasaya bo mingilimang oosan koi kani'imari: Ngaan-Ku a bo pumbuse'ina i raaya'a meena. Raaya'a morobu tia wurung men sian inti'ionna i raaya'a,
ka' mau mingintoni ule, kabai se' minginum rasung, raaya'a sian nongko'upa. Ka' mian manggeo, kalu epetonna i raaya'a tia limana, sida malesi'.”
Noko daa i Tumpu Yesus norobu koiya'a na ko'ona i raaya'a, Ia notoleengketmo waara'a na surugaa, kasi no'umoruang paraas uananna Alaata'ala.
Mbaka' murit ni Yesus nomae'mo mengelelekon Lele Pore na longkop tano', ka' Tumpu uga' muntulung i raaya'a, ka' mompotuutuu' Lele Pore tia oosan men ia limang i raaya'a.]
